metadata.desc: Use Koharu HTTP API to translate manga images from AstrBot chats.

koharu_api_base_url.hint: Koharu exposes HTTP API under /api/v1. Both http://host:port and http://host:port/api/v1 are accepted.

target_language.hint: Used as targetLanguage when the command does not provide a language.

pipeline_steps.hint: Comma-separated Koharu engine ids. Leave empty to read the selected pipeline engines from Koharu /config.

system_prompt.hint: Optional per-run systemPrompt passed to Koharu pipeline.

default_font.hint: Optional per-run defaultFont passed to Koharu pipeline.

auto_load_llm.hint: Enable this if Koharu does not already have a translation model loaded.

llm_kind.hint: provider uses providerId + modelId. local uses only modelId.

llm_provider_id.hint: Used only when llm_kind is provider.

llm_model_id.hint: Leave empty to skip auto loading. Must match a model shown by Koharu /llm/catalog.

max_send_images.hint: Use 0 to send all rendered images.
